name: chat-message
description: One message of a conversation, messaging-app style: incoming and outgoing bubbles with a tail on the first bubble of each run, sender name and avatar once per run in group chats, the time and sent/delivered/read ticks tucked into the bubble's corner, replies with a coloured quote bar, images with captions, file cards, voice notes, reaction pills and a typing indicator. Pure CSS — grouping is one boolean per message, and every colour is a token pair the contrast gate already holds.

avatar.description: Wrapper for the sender's avatar primitive, group chats only. Put it on EVERY incoming message of a group chat so the column never collapses — a continued message keeps the space and hides the picture. Mark it aria-hidden: the sender is named in text.

bubble.description: The bubble. Holds, in order, any of: sender or label, quote, media, file, voice, dots, text, meta. The first bubble of a run (no data-continued on the message) grows a tail from its top corner, drawn in the bubble's own fill and edge.

sender.description: Visible sender name on the first message of a run in a group chat, coloured by the accent — set data-accent on the message to give each person a stable hue. Read by screen readers; do not add a label beside it.

label.description: Screen-reader-only author line ('Maya Chen', 'You', 'Maya Chen is typing') for every message that shows no visible sender. Visually hidden by this stylesheet.

quote.description: The message being replied to, inside the bubble, with an accent bar: a cite (who) over an excerpt (what). Give it its own data-accent to colour it as the quoted sender.

cite.description: Inside a quote: who wrote the quoted message.

excerpt.description: Inside a quote: the quoted text, clamped to two lines.

media.description: An image (an with width, height and alt). The bubble tightens its padding around it; a [data-part='text'] after it is the caption. With no caption the time sits on a scrim over the picture.

text.description: The message text. Whitespace is preserved (pre-wrap), so newlines typed with Shift+Enter survive — write the text with no indentation inside the element. A spacer after the last word reserves room for the time.

meta.description: Time and delivery status in the bubble's inline-end corner, on the last line of the text when it fits. Not hidden from assistive tech: the time is read once, here.

status.description: Delivery ticks: role='img' with an aria-label ('Sent', 'Delivered', 'Read', 'Sending', 'Not sent') around an icon primitive — check for sent, check-check for delivered and read, clock for pending, circle-alert for failed. data-status colours it: read takes the accent, failed the destructive colour.

edited.description: The word 'edited' before the time, set in italics.

file.description: A document card: an icon tile, the name over its details, and an optional action button (download, open).

icon.description: Inside a file card: the accent tile holding an icon primitive (file-text, image, music …). Decorative: aria-hidden.

name.description: Inside a file card: the file name, truncated with an ellipsis.

info.description: Inside a file card: pages, type and size, already formatted ('4 pages · PDF · 1.2 MB').

action.description: Inside a file card: the round download/open control — a real button or link with an aria-label naming the file.

voice.description: A voice note: play button, waveform and duration.

play.description: Play/pause button with an aria-label that includes the duration ('Play voice message, 0:42').

waveform.description: Decorative trace (aria-hidden), drawn by CSS masks. --chat-progress (a percentage) colours the played part in the accent.

duration.description: Length of the note, already formatted ('0:42').

reactions.description: Reaction pills hung over the bubble's lower edge. role='group' with aria-label='Reactions'.

reaction.description: One reaction: a real toggle button — aria-pressed says whether you reacted, and the aria-label says the emoji in words and the count ('Heart, 2 reactions, including yours').

count.description: Inside a reaction: the number beside the emoji.

dots.description: Typing indicator: three empty <span> children that rise in turn (still under reduced motion). aria-hidden; the label says who is typing. Use with data-state='typing'.

direction.description: incoming = from someone else, aligned to the start on the page-coloured (light) or muted (dark) fill; outgoing = yours, aligned to the end on the accent's subtle fill.

typing.description: A typing indicator rather than a message: the bubble holds [data-part='dots'] and a label naming who is typing. Inside a chat-thread (role='log') adding or unhiding it is announced politely.

continued.description: This message continues the previous one's run (same sender, no break): no tail, the avatar is hidden but keeps its column, and the gap above shrinks. The first message of a run is the one without it; the last is the one whose next sibling lacks it.

status.description: On [data-part='status']: which delivery state the ticks show. read colours them with the accent, failed with the destructive colour; the others use the muted ink. Keep the icon and the aria-label in step with it.

--chat-bubble-bg.description: Bubble (and tail) fill (custom property). Pick a token the text colours clear AA on.

--chat-tail.description: Size of the tail on the first bubble of a run (custom property). 0 removes it.

--chat-text-size.description: Message text size (custom property). A chat-thread sets it from its data-size, so every message in it follows.

--chat-media-max.description: Widest an image may render inside a bubble (custom property).

--chat-media-ratio.description: Force an aspect ratio on images (custom property); auto keeps the image's own.

--chat-progress.description: On [data-part='waveform']: how much of the voice note has played (custom property).

keyboard.Tab: reaches the controls a message holds — links in the text, the file action, the play button and each reaction — in reading order
keyboard.Enter / Space on a reaction: toggle your reaction (native button; the page flips aria-pressed and the count)

notes: Reading order is the announcement: author (the visible sender, or the visually hidden label), quote, media alt text, the file's name and details, the text, the time, then the status ticks' aria-label. Nothing is said twice — the time is read from the visible <time>, and the ticks are only their label.
Give every message that shows no visible sender a [data-part='label']: in a 1:1 chat that is every message ('Maya Chen', 'You'); in a group chat, every continued message.
Images carry real alt text. A reaction is a toggle button with aria-pressed and an aria-label that says the emoji in words — screen readers read raw emoji inconsistently.
Colour is never the only signal: read and delivered differ in the label as well as the tint, and the failed state has its own icon.
The typing indicator's dots are aria-hidden and freeze under prefers-reduced-motion; its label says who is typing.
